newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lyonnaise signs Jakarta water contract.
newsitem.headline: Lyonnaise signs Jakarta water contract.

text.p: France's Lyonnaise des Eaux said on Friday it had signed a contract for water management in the west of Jakarta.
The deal along with an Indonesian partner covered water production and distribtuion over 25 years.
The company said Britain's Thames Water had won a similar contract for the eastern part of Jakarta along with Indonesian partners.
The French firm's contract is in a venture with Indonesian Salim, with the latter holding 60 percent and Lyonnaise taking 40 percent, said a Lyonnaise statement.
It said investment of $300 million was planned in the first five years. Turnover in the first year of operations should be around $75 million, rising to $180 million in the sixth year, it added.
